changes: Configured filters and visible fields on the five Project 27 views: Planning selects wayfinder:* and spec artifacts, Execution Board and Roadmap exclude them, Blocked selects status:Blocked, Review selects status:Review.

Rewrote the board README to record the Scrumban cadence and WIP limit of two, the six-value Status flow, the lean field schema without a Phase field, the five views with their filters, the Ready/Blocked gates, and the API limitation for automation rules and view grouping.
Updated docs/reference/agents/index.md to bind work items to project 27 and to describe Status as the only work-state field.

Updated docs/reference/agents/work-item-format.md to the board's real lean schema (Status, Priority, Size, Sprint, Risk plus native relationships) and removed the Phase, Work Type, Repo Scope and Release Train target shapes.

commands: gh api graphql (projectV2 views, repositories, readme)
skipped: View grouping and sort order were not set: the GraphQL schema exposes only visibleFieldIds in ProjectV2ViewConfigurationInput, so grouping stays a UI action.
Automation rules (auto-add, close-to-Done) were not created: GitHub Projects API cannot configure them.
The implement skill stopped at the validated branch; the branch was published afterwards as PR #58, so no PR was opened by that skill.
validation.notes: Board https://github.com/users/quantumquirkxyz/projects/27 is linked to quantumquirkxyz/WorkBridge with 17 fields and 14 items. Status has exactly six values (Backlog, Ready, In Progress, Review, Blocked, Done) and no Phase field exists. Fields are Status, Priority, Size, Sprint, Risk plus native milestone, labels, assignees, reviewers, parent issue, sub-issue progress and linked pull requests. Five views read back with filters: Planning (wayfinder:* and spec), Execution Board (excludes planning artifacts, board layout), Blocked (status:Blocked), Review (status:Review), Roadmap (excludes planning artifacts, roadmap layout). README verification: gh project view returns the rewritten README. Lint, typecheck, 867 tests and coverage thresholds all pass.

riskRemaining: The five views have filters, but the Execution Board is not yet grouped by Status: ProjectV2ViewConfigurationInput accepts only visibleFieldIds, so grouping and sort order need a one-time UI step and the board does not render as a Status flow until then. Automation rules remain unconfigured by design. The repo docs now point at project 27 and state the six Status values as the board's definition; ADR-0021 is still only on the unmerged local branch chore/governance-index, so the ADR citation must be restored once that decision lands.
